text:
Priya Sharma: Quick sync — product wants an embargo window for the launch next Wed. They suggested Tue 10:00-14:00 PT for embargo lift + briefing pack release. Need: analyst briefings scheduled across EU/APAC, final CEO quote, and one pager for fact-checkers. @Sam can you confirm comms timeline?

Sam Torres: Got it. Tue 10-14 PT sounds fine as the embargo window. We should do regional briefings staggered so analysts get local friendly times. I can own inviteing. Do we want a pre-embargo pre-reads access for top-tier analysts? :thinking_face:

Priya Sharma: Yes — give top 6 analysts early read access (48h before embargo). We'll watermark PDFs. @Mia will you own fact-check hands?

Mia Chen: Yup, I'll be point for fact-checks and will keep a single sheet of accepted/declined edits. Uploading fact-check doc now: https://drive.google.com/example-launch-factcheck

Jordan Lee: Proposed briefing schedule (local times in parentheses):
```
Tue (EMEA): Wed 18:00 CET (Tue 09:00 PT) — 30m group briefing
Wed (APAC): Thu 10:00 SGT (Wed 18:00 PT) — 45m for APAC analysts
Optional 1:1s: Thu morning PT for US analysts who want follow-ups
```
I can run the slides and demo at the EMEA slot.

Eli Patel: On the CEO quote — drafted a tighter version. Current: "Redwood is committed to unlocking predictable LLM economics for every engineering team." Proposed: "We built Redwood so teams can ship reliable, cost-predictable LLM features without reinventing serving." Thoughts?

Priya Sharma: I like the proposed wording, Eli — slightly more product-forward. Can you give a 140-char and a 280-char variant? PR needs both.

Eli Patel: Sent both variants to the doc — flagged in comments. Also noted legal/infosec check for a line about "on-prem options".

pressbot: Calendar events created for EMEA group briefing and APAC group briefing. Invitations sent to analyst pre-reads list.

Mia Chen: Fact-check sheet updated with expected turnaround: 24 hours for top-tier, 48 for others. I'll ping people individually for clarifications.

Sam Torres: For embargo enforcement — recommend we include explicit copy in pre-read: "DO NOT PUBLISH before Tue 10:00 PT" and insert watermark + unique reviewer token. Also routing: inbound analyst questions -> marketing@redwood.io.

Priya Sharma: Awesome. Action items: Sam — send invites & pre-read access (today). Mia — lock fact-check sheet + share link in invites. Eli — finalize both quote lengths and tag legal. Jordan — finalize slides/demo order. I'll follow up w/ CEO for verbal sign-off. :thumbsup:

Sam Torres: On it. Will post invites by EOD.

Eli Patel: Tagging legal now.

Priya Sharma: Thanks team — will close loop once CEO confirms.
